annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于开展养老机构安全风险隐患排查整治工作的通知（国办函〔2026〕14号）
annotation.title_en: General Office of the State Council Notice on Investigating and Rectifying Safety Risks and Hazards in Elderly Care Institutions (Guobanhan [2026] No. 14)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: General Office of the State Council of the People's Republic of China
named_instruments_referenced: Guobanfa [2020] No. 48 Opinions on Comprehensive Supervision of Elderly Care Services
annotation.summary_en: Chinese State Council General Office notice (Feb 2026) directing multi-agency inspection and rectification of safety hazards in elderly care institutions (fire, buildings, food, medical, flood), with targets through 2028, emergency plans and drills, and accountability for failures. Not about AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Eliminate existing safety hazards in elderly care institutions by end of 2026; long-term mechanism by end of 2028
Joint multi-department inspections using a single checklist, at least once per year at county level
Institutions must have emergency plans, evacuation routes for disabled elderly, and drills every six months
Retrospective accountability for safety accidents and failures in rectification
